notes: κἀκεῖνα takes the discontinuous *and … the other* as one crasis unit under rule 55.
δυσβάστακτα heads on *borne* by rule 104's εὐπειθής precedent, the stem word rather than the prefix word carrying the lexeme.

*ye* in *these ought ye to have done* is the matrix subject of the English finite verb and rides with ἔδει under rule 9; rule 74 reaches only a subject the ASV writes inside the infinitival complement.
